headlines.description: Cam Newton threw two touchdown passes, Greg Hardy had a team- record four sacks and the Carolina Panthers clinched the NFC South title by beating the Atlanta Falcons 21-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam helps Panthers clinch NFC South title

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw for two touchdowns, ran for another and set a pair of Bengals passing records on Sunday, leading Cincinnati to a 34-17 victory that eliminated the defending Super Bowl champion Baltimore Ravens.
Titans beat Texans 16-10, Houston nabs No. 1 pick
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans fall to Titans, will pick No. 1

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 282 yards and one touchdown, Robert Mathis reclaimed the NFL sacks lead and Adam Vinatieri joined the 2,000-point club Sunday as the Colts routed Jacksonville 30-10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts roll into playoffs with rout of Jaguars

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: The Miami Dolphins were eliminated from the scramble for the AFC's final wild-card berth Sunday by the New York Jets, who thrived in the role of spoilers against their archrivals and won 20-7.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets eliminate rival Dolphins from playoffs

headlines.description: Vikings leave Metrodome with victory over Lions
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings edge Lions in Metrodome finale

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Giants, Jernigan add to Shanahan, Skins' woes
headlines.shortLinkText: Jernigan, Giants add to Redskins' troubles
Steelers fall short of playoffs despite win

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers fired a 48-yard touchdown pass to Randall Cobb in the final minute, and the Green Bay Packers beat the Chicago Bears 33-28 to capture the NFC North championship.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers returns to lead Packers to playoffs

headlines.description: Broncos beat Raiders 34-14 for top seed in AFC
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos beat Raiders for top seed in AFC

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Blount leads Pats to bye with 34-20 win over Bills

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Saints make playoffs with 42-17 win over Bucs
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints reach playoffs with trouncing of Bucs

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked a 40-yard field goal as the game ended to lift San Francisco to a 23-20 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday, giving the 49ers the NFC's No. 5 playoff seed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners nudge Cards to seal NFC's 5th seed

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Nick Novak kicked a 36-yard field goal with 5:30 left in overtime and the San Diego Chargers, who trailed by 10 points in the fourth quarter, beat the Kansas Chiefs 27-24 to claim the AFC's final playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers slip Chiefs in OT to make playoffs

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Malcolm Smith returned an interception 37 yards for a touchdown, Marshawn Lynch added a 2-yard scoring run and the Seattle Seahawks clinched the NFC West title and home-field advantage throughout the playoffs with a 27-9 win over the St. Louis Rams on Sun
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks clinch NFC's top seed with win

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw two touchdown passes, NFL rushing champion LeSean McCoy had 120 yards and a receiving score and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Dallas Cowboys 24-22 in a win-or-go-home game for the NFC East title Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles nab NFC East title thanks to late pick
